policy_name: ECDAT Mandatory Security Regression & Bug Closure Policy (Phase 22.4)
enforcement_mandate: Never close a security bug without: (1) Root cause, (2) Fix, (3) Permanent test, (4) Threat model update, (5) Release note if applicable.

regressions.title: Billion Laughs XML Bomb & XXE Entity Resolution in CBOM Parser

root_cause.technical_summary: Unvalidated XML entity expansion in CycloneDX XML parser allowed recursive entity expansion (Billion Laughs) and local file inclusion via external entity references.
root_cause.flaw_type: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

fix.fix_summary: Implemented pre-parse regex rejection of DOCTYPE / ENTITY declarations and strict XML payload bounds, safely rejecting malicious entities prior to parser evaluation.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Defense-in-depth: Disable all DTD evaluation and reject XML payloads containing <!ENTITY or <!DOCTYPE before DOM construction.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: XML DTD is strictly prohibited; all CBOM ingestion strictly enforces DTD rejection.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Hardened CBOM parser against recursive XML entity expansion and unauthorized entity resolution.

regressions.title: Raw Canary Secrets and Private Keys Echoed in Crash Diagnostics

root_cause.technical_summary: Exception handlers in static and parser sanitizers occasionally included raw error snippets containing canary private keys or API tokens when formatting crash traces.
root_cause.flaw_type: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

fix.fix_summary: Added CANARY_TOKEN_REGEX and strict regex-based multi-token redactors to sanitize all parser errors and crash outputs before writing logs or exceptions.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Zero-leakage invariant: All error messages, debug logs, and crash outputs pass through comprehensive token redaction replacing secrets with [REDACTED_SECRET].

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Crash diagnostics sanitized unconditionally; verified by automated canary token injection tests.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Redacted sensitive key tokens and credentials from parser error reports and diagnostic traces.

regressions.title: Prototype Pollution via Malicious CBOM & Policy JSON Payloads

root_cause.technical_summary: Deep merge operations on untrusted CBOM components and policy documents did not filter __proto__, constructor, or prototype properties, permitting object prototype modification.
root_cause.flaw_type: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

fix.fix_summary: Implemented freeze prototype protection and explicit guards rejecting objects containing __proto__ or constructor keys.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Safe JSON normalization: Strip prototype-polluting keys and disallow direct assignment to object prototypes across all parser paths.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Object.prototype pollution eliminated in both Node.js backend and Python parser engines.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Prevented prototype pollution vulnerabilities during CBOM JSON ingestion and policy evaluation.

regressions.title: Catastrophic ReDoS Backtracking in Cryptographic Regex Rule Matcher

root_cause.technical_summary: Adversarial source files containing lines exceeding 500,000 characters caused exponential regex backtracking in unbounded evidence extraction routines.

fix.fix_summary: Enforced strict MAX_LINE_LENGTH (4,096 chars) truncation and bounded MAX_EVIDENCE_LENGTH (250 chars) with finding quota limits.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Bounded static scanning: Hard limits on line lengths and finding counts prevent unbounded CPU consumption during regex evaluation.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: All source scanning routines operate with strictly bounded line length limits.

release_note.advisory_summary: Performance & Security: Added strict bounds on line processing to prevent regular expression denial-of-service on adversarial inputs.

regressions.title: Uncontrolled Recursion and Memory Exhaustion in Network PCAP Parser

root_cause.technical_summary: Deeply nested packet encapsulation or circular packet offsets caused uncontrolled stack recursion and unbounded memory allocation in network packet analysis.

fix.fix_summary: Added iterative packet traversal with bounded depth guards (max_depth=32), bounded packet size limits (10MB), and sanitized packet banner extraction.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Recursion bounded by explicit counters; packet parsing halts safely on unknown or circular encapsulation structures.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Network packet processing is strictly bounded by size and nesting depth.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Hardened network packet parser against deep encapsulation recursion and unbounded memory usage.

regressions.title: Private Key Ingestion in Certificate Parser

root_cause.technical_summary: SafeCertParser accepted raw PEM inputs without verifying that private key material was excluded, risking inadvertent ingestion and persistence of private keys.

fix.fix_summary: Implemented immediate validation and rejection of any PEM certificate containing PRIVATE KEY headers, throwing SafeParserError before deserialization.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Strict key type gating: Certificate parser accepts only X.509 public certificates and unconditionally rejects private key blocks.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Private keys cannot be ingested into certificate asset inventories under any circumstances.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Enforced strict rejection of private key PEM data in certificate inventory parsers.

regressions.title: Path Traversal & Zip Slip in Archive Decompression

root_cause.technical_summary: Tar and Zip archive members containing relative paths (e.g., ../../etc/passwd) could write files outside target extraction directories.
root_cause.flaw_type: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

fix.fix_summary: Implemented canonical path resolution verifying that every extracted entry resolves strictly within the target directory boundary, rejecting symlink escapes.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Target directory containment: Validate resolved path starts with target root path before any disk write.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Archive extraction is restricted to verified, non-escaping child paths.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Mitigated Zip Slip directory traversal vulnerability during archive scanning.

regressions.title: Cross-Tenant Cryptographic Asset Access & Isolation Leakage

root_cause.technical_summary: Tenant context was not enforced uniformly across all database lookup queries, potentially allowing authenticated requests to read cryptographic findings belonging to another tenant.

fix.fix_summary: Implemented mandatory tenant context middleware and database query scoping requiring tenant_id on all query operations.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Multi-tenant row-level security: Enforce tenant_id parameterization across all Knex query builders.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Tenancy isolation verified by multi-tenant automated boundary tests.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Strengthened multi-tenant boundary checks preventing cross-tenant cryptographic data access.

regressions.title: Policy Engine Schema Error Message Secret Leakage

root_cause.technical_summary: jsonschema validation error exceptions included raw string contents of invalid fields, which could expose canary credentials embedded in malformed policies.
root_cause.flaw_type: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

fix.fix_summary: Wrapped policy engine validation exceptions in redact_secrets, ensuring no secret tokens appear in policy validation failure diagnostics.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Sanitize all jsonschema.ValidationError instances with redact_secrets prior to returning policy verdicts.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: Policy schema error messages are fully sanitized against credential exposure.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Sanitized error outputs in policy engine to prevent accidental credential leakage in audit logs.

root_cause.technical_summary: JWT verification did not explicitly restrict allowed algorithms, allowing token headers specifying algorithm 'none' or public-key-to-HMAC confusion to forge authentication claims.
root_cause.flaw_type: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

fix.fix_summary: Hardcoded allowed algorithm list strictly to ['HS256', 'RS256'] and explicitly rejected tokens specifying 'none' or mismatched key types.
fix.mitigation_strategy: Strict JWT algorithm pinning: Disallow unsigned tokens and enforce signature verification with configured algorithm.

threat_model_update.residual_risk_impact: JWT verification explicitly pins expected algorithms and blocks unsigned tokens.

release_note.advisory_summary: Security Fix: Enforced strict cryptographic algorithm pinning for JWT authentication tokens.
